Rolling downhill, by hand

Written for Ore in the markup Distill's first template writes: its citations and footnotes are elements of its own, inside the sentence.

Here is the usual picture of a step [1, 2]: a walker going down a slope takes the steepest way, slowly and surely. A ball with weight rolls through the small bumps a walker would stop in.

The ball can be twice as fast on many slopes. 1 That is no small gain, and it comes almost for free.
